reason: This plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is session and workflow automation in DSH Web GUI: replaying recorded conversations in a timeline, exporting/importing replay packages, re-running recorded user messages, and converting browser screen captures into generated skills. The README and package metadata also show it is a dual host/client plugin focused on local session/recording data flows and agent-assisted processing, with validation flags indicating packaging/manifest issues that should be corrected.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DSH Web GUI 的录制回放插件，可在侧边栏查看会话时间线并复刻回放，对会话进行导入/导出，还支持录屏与逐帧生成可安装技能。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web GUI record-and-replay plugin that offers session timeline playback, replay-pack import/export, rerun of recorded sessions, and browser-based screen capture with frame-based skill generation.

capabilities: Local reading of recorded session files and export/import of replay-pack data
Local browser screen capture via getDisplayMedia with webm/video frame storage
Automated re-execution of recorded user turns in new sessions
Agent-assisted skill generation from recorded frame data

reasons.code: The plugin reads from ~/.dsh/sessions and writes to ~/.dsh/replay-packs, ~/.dsh/recordings, and ~/.dsh/skills, so it handles potentially sensitive local session and media data.
The feature set includes recording screen/window content with getDisplayMedia and generating replayable video plus sampled frames, which can capture arbitrary on-screen information.
The plugin can route selected frames to agent-side describe_image analysis and create SKILL.md files, introducing workflow actions that operate across recorded artifacts and local filesystem targets.
